verdict.rationale: Google Workspace lists 'Appointment booking pages' as a Google Calendar feature, so the product ships its own booking-link capability. Nothing in the pack shows how deep it goes for multiple event types with separate settings. missing for 10: evidence of multiple distinct event types, per-type durations, per-type locations, custom booking questions, confirmation/approval rules, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer multiple event types with their own durations, locations, custom questions, and confirmation rules
